title: UAV-EHFS: code and results (PLOS ONE PONE-D-26-48338)
description: Code and results for the PLOS ONE manuscript PONE-D-26-48338: the pipeline (uav_ehfs.py), the table and figure generator (make_tables.py), diagnostics.py, all result JSON files with confusion matrices, per-fold cross-validation curves and ablation, test-set predictions, the duplicate-removal sensitivity results, and the generated tables and figures.
